pr_title: Switch from ChoosingItemContainer to ContainerContentChanging event
pr_body:
**Resolved / Related Issues**
Items resolved / related issues by this PR.
- Closes #5254?

**Details of Changes**
Add details of changes here.
- Initialize drag events and extended properties in ContainerContentChanging  instead of ChoosingItemContainer

This should help performance somewhat as it avoids creating a new ListView/GridView item each time.
Also it looks like it fixes the issue of icons sometimes not appearing (happens for me after refreshing the folder).
@duke7553 what do you think?

**Validation**
How did you test these changes?
- [x] Built and ran the app
pr_comments:
This shouldn't have been merged so quickly imo. 

@gave92 Anyways, I was working on an implementation last week which leverages this same event. It's currently only setup for GridView, but differs from your great PR in some meaningful ways that I thought we could use to improve the experience. #5362
@zhuxb711 Yes! Just some friendly collaboration and iteration. Hope you don't mind 😄

Never mind. It's open source project, I am glad to learn from each other.(⁎⁍̴̛ᴗ⁍̴̛⁎)

issue_context.body:

**Explain the bug**
Some files' icons don't load, and use Files' default icon instead of the proper one.

**To reproduce**
1. Open a folder
2. See the error

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65342367/122574148-084e9800-d058-11eb-99ee-c6a809a1e531.png)

**System Information**
- Edition: Windows 10 Home
- Version: Dev
- Installed on: 26-‎May-‎21
- OS build: 21390.2025
- Experience: Windows 10 Feature Experience Pack 321.13302.10.3

 - App version: v1.5.44.0

**Additional comment**
Sometimes this problem happen again after restarting the app, sometimes it does not.
comments: @TheOnlyTails Can you confirm if this happens with specific file types or if it's just random?
@yaichenbaum It seems to be random, as it has only happened to that specific file.
@TheOnlyTails Can you check if that specific file displays an icon in File Explorer? Some items simply don't have icons, but soon we'll be retrieving them more quickly and reliably.
@TheOnlyTails This issue should be resolved with #5357.

review_comments: Would it be possible (/feasible) to move this into ``BaseLayout`` to reduce code duplication between layouts that utilize a ``ListViewBase`` for the file list? Also should this change be made in ColumnView(s) as well since it also uses ChoosingItemContainer?

> Would it be possible (/feasible) to move this into BaseLayout

I don't think so, all layouts have slightly different logic in this callback

> Should this change be made in ColumnView(s) 

It really should but I hate putting my hands into the ColumnView code (kidding, I'll get to it)
Before doing this for ColumnView I'd like some feedback first though. Does it work? Do you think it's better than the current solution?
Yeah it works great, and I haven't reproduced that icons not loading issue either.
